note: acquisition de Cursor par fusion avec X67 Inc. ; contrepartie en actions de classe A pour une valeur implicite des fonds propres de 60,0 milliards ; clôture attendue au troisième trimestre 2026
quote: each share of Cursor's common stock and each share of Cursor's preferred stock outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time of the Merger will be automatically converted into the right to receive shares of the Company's Class A common stock based on an implied equity value of Cursor of $60.0 billion
trigger_description: The transaction is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, including, but not limited to, receipt of requisite regulatory approvals.
